name: delivery_id
description: Unique delivery identifier, assigned in UTC chronological order.

name: delivered_at
description: Instant the parcel was handed over, stored as UTC epoch seconds. Read it in the warehouse's own zone for business-day questions.

name: warehouse
description: Dispatching warehouse code: LAX, ORD, NYC, LON, BLR or SYD.

name: zone
description: IANA time zone of the dispatching warehouse, e.g. America/Chicago.

name: route
description: Delivery route within the warehouse, e.g. ORD-R3 (eight routes per site).

name: service_level
description: Promised service tier for the parcel: standard or express.

name: duration_min
description: Minutes from van departure to hand-over for this delivery.

name: on_time
description: True when the parcel was handed over inside its promised delivery window.
